stance_rationale: Reject as an alpha admission artifact: the package is explicitly Phase A design-only, with alpha_vector empty, alpha_scores.parquet absent, empirical IC/ICIR/Harvey/DSR missing, and AX-008 at 0/3 pending. The design can be revised, but it cannot be treated as verified alpha evidence.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required alpha_scores.parquet is missing from qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260519_002; Stage A path itself is absent. weights.csv and covariance.parquet are also missing, so schedule, PSD, condition, and time-series alpha checks are not executable.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Package states natural-direction time-series features and no Z_Score_Aligned alpha matrix; C13 cannot be verified for an alpha package.
C14 is marked n/a because this is a bear-regime classifier; no Usable_Date <= sig_date artifact or alpha_scores time series exists.
Docs reference direct cache paths and rawdata.parquet; no factor_engine_proposal.R or executable load_month_factors() lineage was provided.
Lag rules are described, but lookahead_detector/pit_enforcement outputs are absent, so regime/vol lag compliance is unverified.
No DART/fundamental feature is listed; macro release lags are separately specified, though not yet executed.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory empirical artifacts are absent: no alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, final alpha_package.json, challenge_note, or factor_engine_proposal.R. This blocks RF-A7 time-series verification and AX-008 triangulation.

The package substitutes a market-level bear-regime sensor for a cross-sectional alpha package, then marks rank_IC, ICIR, DSR, and C14 as n/a. AUC/Brier/Recall are not equivalent to QEPM alpha gates without a downstream alpha/portfolio mapping.

method_shopping_log.candidates_tried=1 is not defensible given 32 features, 5 models, 3 ensemble strategies, monthly/daily modes, multiple thresholds, multiple aggregation rules, and Path A/B admission routes. Harvey multi-testing and DSR controls are deferred.

The weakest empirical claim is that 2.7x positive-class expansion plus 8 crisis epochs will repair v5 Recall 0.089 and achieve 4/5 sub-window stability. S1 has only 3 universal features, later strata have different feature availability, and no sub-stability result exists.
PIT compliance is asserted but not proven: FRED/ECOS/VKOSPI release lags are protocol text only, direct cache references appear, and no per-feature PIT audit output is attached.

No Silent Override is incomplete: challenge_note is listed as a future Stage 4 deliverable and lineage_record is pending, so current draft has no ACCEPT/PARTIAL/REBUTTAL disposition for its own challenge flags.

supporting_arguments: The draft is transparent that it is design-only and that empirical alpha, p_bad_monthly, and Harvey/DSR outputs are deferred.
Feature sources and nominal lag rules are documented in detail, which is useful input for a later executable Forge cycle.
The draft acknowledges major open risks such as S1 feature asymmetry, VKOSPI dependency, LSTM over-parameterization, and crisis generalization.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Charter Phase A can exempt alpha_scores.parquet despite the base context stating every alpha_package must provide time-series alpha.
Whether this should be reviewed as alpha at all, rather than as a risk overlay or regime sensor under a separate gate.
Whether max-history inclusion helps more than it hurts when 1990-2000 has only 3 universal features and a structurally different KR market.
weakest_assumption: Positive-class expansion plus crisis diversity plus a 5-model ensemble will convert v5 Recall 0.089 into stable OOS bear prediction despite stratum-specific feature availability and no executed feature panel.
rebuttal_required: Provide alpha_scores.parquet or p_bad_monthly.parquet with Date x Ticker/market score time series, n_sig_dates, date range, and no future dates.
Provide executable factor_engine_proposal.R and PIT audit outputs for C9, C11, C14, and C15.
Report realized AUC/Brier/Recall/Precision by sub-window plus Harvey t_NW, DSR, and multi-testing accounting for all modes, labels, model variants, and aggregation rules.
Clarify whether this artifact is an alpha package, a regime overlay, or a downstream feature for DPL_KR_v3, and bind the proper admission gate.
rationalization_red_flags: Detected banned phrases in the package/admission detector list: 미미, 관행적, 보수적이면, 대부분 결과 동일, 실무적, 이미 반영, 백테스트 충분히 길어서 상쇄.
Actual rationalization risk: candidates_tried=1 despite many model/feature/frequency/threshold choices.
Actual rationalization risk: IC/ICIR/DSR marked n/a because the output is a regime sensor.
Actual rationalization risk: 'well within capacity', 'massive margin', and '가능성' language used before empirical Forge evidence.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package itself reports 0_OF_3_PENDING; without Forge and Architect empirical outputs, Codex cannot supply a second source pass.
